message.text:
RebuildMemoPayload computes Tags and Property. It discards Mentions. ExtractAll extracts Mentions but RebuildMemoPayload does not preserve them.

Mentions are extracted directly by ExtractAll in memo_mention_helpers. The stored derived metadata includes Tags, Property flags such as has_link and has_task_list, and title. Recomputation is triggered by CreateMemo and by UpdateMemo when the content path is in the update mask. Snippet is generated on demand by GenerateSnippet and is not stored on the memo payload.

The computation site is RebuildMemoPayload, which delegates to ExtractAll. The extracted properties are tags, title, has_link, has_task_list, has_code, and has_incomplete_tasks. A memopayload.Runner.RunOnce would recompute all memos if it were active.

h14.
memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload → markdown.ExtractAll (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`, `internal/markdown/markdown.go`); CreateMemo and UpdateMemo when `content` is in the update mask (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`); tags plus Property (title, has_link, has_task_list, has_code, has_incomplete_tasks)

`RebuildMemoPayload` parses memo content and writes `MemoPayload.Tags` and `MemoPayload.Property` (see `proto/store/memo.proto`). Those flags/tags are what list/filter/stats/preview paths read. Mentions are also parsed by `ExtractAll` but are not stored on the payload. Location is user-set, not derived. `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` would rebuild every memo’s payload, but that runner is not started in production.
